pages.title: Grounded AI Practice — independent research on the UK's AI skills gap
pages.description: Independent research on the UK's AI skills gap, by someone who tried the official route first. What was promised, what the numbers show, and a better way to learn.
pages.og_description: What was promised, what the published numbers show, and whether anyone outside government can check them. Research in the open, sources included.

pages.title: Counted in courses, promised in people — Grounded AI Practice
pages.description: What the UK government promised on AI skills, what has actually been counted, and the number that would connect the two. Every source named, with whose interest it serves.

pages.title: How the research works — Grounded AI Practice
pages.description: Four rules this project runs on: facts kept apart from conclusions, every source tagged by who produced it, looking for what would prove a claim wrong, and corrections left visible.

pages.title: The system behind the research — Grounded AI Practice
pages.description: The rules, logs and custom tools the research is produced with, and the gap between how a large organisation deploys AI and what a small firm usually gets.

pages.title: The story behind the project — Grounded AI Practice
pages.description: Four years as a mechanic, an official training route that led to signup pages instead of skills, a first build that collapsed under its own complexity, and the method that came out of it.
